# Copilot instructions

`CLAUDE.md` at the repo root is this repo's one instruction file. Read it before reviewing or
writing code here.

Reviewing a diff: check it against `CODING_STANDARDS.md` at the root. `CLAUDE.md` §Critical Rules
are the hard rules, and any violation blocks merge.

Slash commands named in `CLAUDE.md` (`/swiftui-specialist`, `/prototype`, `/research`) are Claude
Code skills. Apply the rule each one sits beside and skip the invocation.
